verdict.rationale: Retell ships an official MCP server that explicitly creates, updates and publishes agents, a CLI that manages agents and phone numbers, and Node/Python SDKs claiming full voice endpoint coverage. Agent creation and number management are documented, but attaching a number to an agent and placing an outbound call programmatically are not explicitly evidenced. The quick-start does these steps in the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit API/CLI/MCP docs for binding a number to an agent and placing an outbound call, an end-to-end headless provisioning walkthrough, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Agents: create, update, publish, list, and fetch agent versions.
Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.
Retell supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so you can build Retell AI voice agents directly from MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex-style tools, and more).
